C.domain: Arithmetic with fractions and mixed numbers (subtraction, equivalent fractions, simplification)

skills.name: Convert mixed to improper
skills.definition: Convert a mixed number to an equivalent improper fraction (or equivalent fractional form) to enable computation.
inclusion_criteria: A step rewrites a mixed number like a b/c into (a·c+b)/c
A step rewrites a mixed number into a whole-plus-fraction form (e.g., 1 4/3 = 1 + 4/3) as part of conversion
exclusion_criteria: Only rewriting a whole number as a fraction with a chosen denominator (tag S02 instead)
Only simplifying a fraction (tag S04 instead)
Only performing subtraction after forms are already compatible (tag S03 instead)

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Rewrite fractions (and/or whole numbers) as equivalent fractions with a common denominator, typically using LCM or scaling.
inclusion_criteria: A step explicitly finds/uses a common denominator (including LCM) to convert fractions
A step rewrites a whole number as an equivalent fraction with a specified denominator (e.g., 3 = 15/5)
exclusion_criteria: Converting mixed numbers to improper fractions without choosing a common denominator (tag S01 instead)
Subtracting once denominators already match (tag S03 instead)
Reducing/simplifying the final fraction (tag S04 instead)

skills.name: Subtract rational numbers
skills.definition: Compute the subtraction of two rational numbers once they are expressed in compatible forms (same denominator or separated whole/fraction parts).
inclusion_criteria: A step subtracts numerators over a common denominator (e.g., 20/12 − 9/12)
A step subtracts whole parts and fractional parts and combines the result (e.g., (4−2)+(4/12−7/12))
A step subtracts identical fractions to get zero
exclusion_criteria: Steps whose main purpose is creating equivalent forms/common denominators (tag S02 instead)
Steps whose main purpose is converting mixed numbers to improper fractions (tag S01 instead)
Steps whose main purpose is simplifying/reducing the result (tag S04 instead)

skills.name: Simplify and format result
skills.definition: Reduce fractions to lowest terms and/or express the final value in an acceptable form (integer, improper fraction, or mixed number).
inclusion_criteria: A step reduces a fraction by a common factor (e.g., −3/12 = −1/4)
A step states/checks that a fraction is already in lowest terms
A step converts an improper fraction to a mixed number (or notes an equivalent mixed-number form) as part of finalization
exclusion_criteria: Finding a common denominator before subtraction (tag S02 instead)
Performing the subtraction operation itself (tag S03 instead)
Converting mixed numbers to improper fractions as preparation (tag S01 instead)

A.domain: Arithmetic with fractions and mixed numbers (subtraction and simplification)

skills.name: Convert number forms
skills.definition: Convert between mixed numbers, improper fractions, and whole numbers written as fractions with a specified denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step converts a mixed number to an improper fraction (e.g., a b/c → (ac+b)/c)
A step rewrites a whole number as an equivalent fraction with a given denominator (e.g., 3 → 15/5)
A step rewrites a fractional part to an equivalent fraction (e.g., 4/10 → 2/5)
exclusion_criteria: Finding an LCM or choosing a common denominator without explicitly converting a number
Performing the subtraction after forms are already compatible
Reducing/simplifying a fraction to lowest terms

skills.name: Common denominator setup
skills.definition: Determine and use a common denominator (often via LCM) to express fractions as equivalent fractions with the same denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step explicitly finds/uses a common denominator or LCM for two denominators
A step scales numerators/denominators to rewrite both fractions over the common denominator
exclusion_criteria: Denominators are already the same and the step only subtracts numerators
Converting mixed numbers/integers to fractions without addressing mismatched denominators
Simplifying the final fraction after subtraction

skills.name: Subtract rational numbers
skills.definition: Compute the difference of two rational numbers once they are expressed in compatible forms (same denominator or separated whole/fractional parts).
inclusion_criteria: A step subtracts numerators over a common denominator (a/b − c/b)
A step subtracts by combining whole-part and fractional-part differences (e.g., (4−2)+(4/12−7/12))
A step subtracts identical fractions to get zero
exclusion_criteria: Only converting forms or finding a common denominator without performing subtraction
Only simplifying/reducing after subtraction is already done

skills.name: Simplify and express result
skills.definition: Reduce the result to lowest terms and/or express it in an acceptable final form (integer, irreducible fraction, or mixed number).
inclusion_criteria: A step reduces a fraction by dividing numerator and denominator by a common factor
A step recognizes and states the result as a whole number (e.g., 3/3 = 1, or difference = 0)
A step converts an improper fraction to a mixed number (or states an equivalent mixed-number form)
exclusion_criteria: Any step whose main purpose is to find a common denominator before subtraction
Any step that performs the subtraction itself without simplification or final-form conversion

B.domain: Arithmetic with fractions and mixed numbers (subtraction and simplification)

skills.name: Convert mixed to improper
skills.definition: Convert mixed numbers (and related forms) into equivalent improper fractions or equivalent fractional representations before operating.
inclusion_criteria: A step rewrites a mixed number a b/c as (ac+b)/c
A step rewrites a mixed number by combining whole and fractional parts (e.g., 1 4/3 = 1 + 4/3 = 7/3)
A step simplifies a fractional part within a mixed number before conversion (e.g., 3 4/10 -> 3 2/5)
exclusion_criteria: Only finding a common denominator for two proper/improper fractions (tag S02 instead)
Only subtracting fractions once they already share a denominator (tag S03 instead)
Only reducing a fraction to lowest terms or rewriting an improper fraction as a mixed number (tag S04 instead)

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine and use a common denominator (often via LCM) to rewrite fractions as equivalent fractions with the same denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step explicitly finds an LCM or chooses a common denominator
A step scales numerator and denominator to convert fractions to the common denominator (e.g., 5/3 = 20/12)
A step rewrites a whole number as an equivalent fraction with a specified denominator (e.g., 3 = 15/5)
exclusion_criteria: Denominators are already equal and the step proceeds directly to subtract numerators (tag S03 instead)
Converting mixed numbers to improper fractions without addressing common denominators (tag S01 instead)
Only simplifying/reducing after subtraction (tag S04 instead)

skills.name: Subtract rational numbers
skills.definition: Compute the subtraction once terms are in compatible form (same denominator or separated whole/fractional parts), including handling zero and negative intermediate results.
inclusion_criteria: A step subtracts numerators over a common denominator (e.g., 20/12 − 9/12)
A step subtracts whole parts and fractional parts and combines the result (e.g., (4−2) + (4/12−7/12))
A step subtracts identical fractions to get 0
exclusion_criteria: The step is primarily converting forms (mixed to improper, or making equivalent fractions) (tag S01 or S02 instead)
The step is primarily simplifying/reducing or converting the final form (tag S04 instead)

skills.name: Simplify and format result
skills.definition: Reduce the resulting fraction to lowest terms and/or express the final value in an acceptable form (integer, improper fraction, or mixed number).
inclusion_criteria: A step reduces a fraction by dividing numerator and denominator by a common factor (e.g., −3/12 = −1/4)
A step states or checks that a fraction is already in lowest terms
A step converts between improper fraction and mixed number (e.g., 6/5 = 1 1/5) or recognizes an integer result (e.g., 3/3 = 1)
exclusion_criteria: Finding a common denominator or rewriting inputs to equivalent fractions (tag S02 instead)
Performing the core subtraction operation (tag S03 instead)
Converting mixed numbers to improper fractions as preparation (tag S01 instead)
